items.title: Reiki Level 1
items.description: An introductory experience for developing gentle awareness, practice foundations, and the beginning of your Reiki journey.

items.title: Reiki Level 2
items.description: A deeper exploration of the Reiki system, practical energy work, and continuing personal healing practice.
